decode_notes: Each original streamed frame is time(float32), count(uint32), then count records of curveIndex(uint32) and four float32 coefficients.
For each scalar channel select last key at or before clip-local t, set dt=t-key.time, evaluate ((a*dt+b)*dt+c)*dt+d. Clamp sample time to original start/stop range.
Seven streamed channels map in genericBindings order: Transform position XYZ then rotation quaternion XYZW. No dense or constant channels exist in these 13 clips.
Binding CRC32 is independently verified against Card_Play_Ally, not inferred from animation names.
Adjacent key endpoint continuity check validates coefficient interpretation; source endpoints are not rounded.

Native Animator blend kernel/transition time normalization is not contained in managed DLL. Full original blend data is retained below; any independent port of that kernel is a compatibility implementation, not a decompiled CIL method.
Leaf m_Duration values are retained as raw controller data and are not used as clip stop time.
MinionShake.LateUpdate applies child.localPosition and child.localRotation.eulerAngles to saved actor pose, not raw quaternion replacement.
